name: Lot Split: the full list
description: Every Minneapolis 1-3 unit lot big enough to split in two under the Chapter 540 built-form rules: address, lot size, street side, district, owner type, assessor value and last sale, with the sales among them refreshed weekly.
line: The full list of every lot that passes, with owner type, assessor value and last sale, plus the spreadsheet and a weekly refresh of new sales among them, is $150, once.
